title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Minimum Premium and the Premium Finally Charged
content:
Every tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` that carries a premium sets a floor below which the premium is never charged.

## Statement

- The **minimum premium** equals whichever is greater of the tier's minimum per container multiplied by the number of containers on the cover, and the tier's minimum per cover.
- The premium charged is the net premium or the minimum premium, whichever is higher.
- That final figure, and no earlier one, is rounded to the cent.

| Tier | Minimum per container (USD) | Minimum per cover (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 60.00 | 75.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 25.00 | 35.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 35.00 | 50.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 50.00 | 75.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 75.00 | 100.00 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical net premiums)

| Tier | Containers on the cover | Container floor (USD) | Cover floor (USD) | Minimum premium (USD) | Net premium (USD) | Premium charged (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 2 | 70.00 | 50.00 | 70.00 | 42.1234 | 70.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 1 | 50.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 280.50 | 280.50 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 4 | 300.00 | 100.00 | 300.00 | 257.004 | 300.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 3 | 75.00 | 35.00 | 75.00 | 180.00001 | 180.00 |
